course.title: Accounting and Auditing for Planners
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Mr. Zaman decides to open a computer programming service which names (25) Zaman IT on January 1, 2020. During the first month of operation, the following transactions occurred.

content.value_html:
2020January 1Zaman invests TK 100,000 cash and equipment Tk 50,000.
January 2Purchase computer equipment for cash Tk 20,000
January 3Office supplies purchase on account Tk 16,000
January 5Received cash Tk 12,000 for programming service provided.
January 6Received a bill for Tk 25,000 from the “Daily News” foradvertising on account.
January 10Provide Tk 35,000 for programming services for customers,cash Tk 15,000 is received from customers and the balanceof Tk 20,000 is billed on account.
January 15Expenses paid in cash salaries Tk 6000, rent Tk 9000 andutilities Tk 2000.
January 17PayTk 2500 daily needs advertising bill in cash.
January 20The sum of Tk 6000 in cash is received from customers whohave previously been billed for services in transaction 10.
January 25Paid Tk 10,000 in cash salary expense.
Required: Prepare Journal
